title: Clear the 4 remaining SonarCloud new-code findings blocking Release Gate
goal: After #304, the Release Gate's Candidate Checks job requires 'SonarCloud Code Analysis' (new-code quality gate) to be success on the release candidate. The post-merge main analysis failed with 'Security Rating on New Code = E' on 4 issues: gosecurity:S2083 BLOCKER (taint flows from HTTP request through Schema.Scope into the relativePath argument of fs.ReadFile - the fs.FS restructure moved the sink but the relative path itself remains request-controlled), typescript:S3516+S3776 (revealTreeRow: all exits return the same targetRow locator and cognitive complexity 17), go:S978 (test identifier shadows predeclared clear). Fix all 4 at source: adopt os.Root (kernel-backed traversal-safe API) so containment is structural, split revealTreeRow into attempt helper + retry wrapper, drop dead parameter, rename the test variable.

in: backend/modules/lowcode/dynamicmodule/dynamic_module_registry.go: fs.FS workspaceFS -> os.Root openWorkspaceRoot; fs.ReadFile -> Root.ReadFile
frontend/tests/smoke-core/smoke-core-fixtures.ts: revealTreeRow split into attemptTreeRowReveal + retry wrapper, dead ancestorText param removed
frontend/tests/smoke-core/system-dept-operations.spec.ts, system-menu-permission.spec.ts: call sites updated to new signature
out: SonarCloud quality-gate or scanner configuration changes
smoke assertion semantics (wait strategy and locator semantics unchanged)
runtime behavior of lowcode workspace reads (os.Root enforces the same containment the guards already implemented)

taskDoc: Follow-up to #304: Release Gate on main@4b8061cd still red. Dependabot Alerts job now passes (0 open high/critical after grpc v1.83.2 propagated), but Candidate Checks requires SonarCloud Code Analysis (new-code gate) success; the main analysis reports Security Rating on New Code = E over 4 issues enumerated from sonarcloud.io api/issues/search?sinceLeakPeriod=true.
